claims: The Denver Nuggets and Los Angeles Lakers split their regular-season matchups at 1-1 entering their final meeting on March 14, 2026.
Los Angeles Lakers defeated the Denver Nuggets 115-107 on January 20, 2026.
Denver Nuggets defeated the Los Angeles Lakers 120-113 on March 5, 2026.
Los Angeles Lakers host the Denver Nuggets at Crypto.com Arena on March 14, 2026 at 5:30 p.m. PT.
Luka Doncic had a 38-point triple-double playing for the Los Angeles Lakers on January 20, 2026.
Los Angeles Lakers won 120-108 against the Denver Nuggets on March 19, 2025 in their 2024-25 season matchup.
Denver Nuggets defeated the Los Angeles Lakers 131-126 on March 14, 2025.
